AdamW (95.20%) underperforms SGD (95.73%) for ResNet-k4 on CIFAR-10; SGD with proper tuning still better for CNNs
Mixup worse than CutMix for this arch (-0.80%); EMA 0.9995 too slow
TTA with horizontal flip in eval adds +0.66% for free; compounds with all training improvements
SE blocks hurt shallow ResNets under tight time budgets; 0.5x init scaling and per-step overhead outweigh channel attention at 9 blocks

CosineAnnealingLR restarts after T_max (periodic); extra epochs from channels_last cause LR to rise, degrading model
6-view spatial-shift TTA (96.13%) worse than 2-view hflip TTA (96.39%); shift views dilute hflip signal with noise
CutMix p=0.3 loses 0.33% vs p=0.5; current regularization balance is well-tuned, not over-regularized
Gradient clipping has no effect; gradients already well-behaved in this CutMix+SGD+AMP setup
WD 1e-3 over-regularizes (-0.38%); WD 5e-4 is the sweet spot for 4.3M param model
Label smoothing 0.05 no better than 0.1; recipe is at ceiling for hyperparameter tuning

k=5 gets only 31 ep (too few for 6.7M); dynamic T_max from early epochs unreliable due to compile overhead
CutMix alpha 0.5 slightly worse than 1.0; all CutMix params (alpha=1.0, p=0.5) confirmed optimal
LR 0.15 too high (-0.41%); LR 0.1 is optimal for this batch size and architecture
